we have found the MOOC to be a powerful and flexible learning environment that is capable of engaging students at a level that is comparable to that found in the traditional classroom.
we have found that the MOOC is not a panacea for the problems of education.

The main takeaway from our work is that
MOOCs can be used to generate data that are useful for research into learning.
